newsitem.title: USA: Sight Resource stumped by shr price drop.
newsitem.headline: Sight Resource stumped by shr price drop.

text.p: Sight Resource Corp said on Thursday that it is not aware of any corporate developments that would account for the recent decline of the company's share price.
The stock was up 5/8 at 5-3/8 in late morning trading.

William G. McLendon, President and Chief Executive Officer said, "The decline in our stock price is quite a surprise to us since it comes at a time when Sight Resource has begun to demonstrate its ability to successfully acquire and efficiently integrate multi-site eye care centers and utilize those centers to market and deliver laser vision correction services."
The company said it has increased annualized revenues from about $19 million to about $38 million in the last year, while significantly reducing its losses.
